extension.news: v1.0.10: Repo now serves Video Add-ons Setup (script.tony7bones.video)

extension.description: Installs repositories and add-ons for a personal Kodi build.
extension.news: Skip optional dependencies — no more pulling Google Drive / cloud resolvers you didn't ask for. The installer now matches Kodi's own behaviour and resolves only required dependencies; optional imports stay on-demand. (v1.0.20 made Setup remove itself after a successful run. v1.0.19 stopped pinning Setup to the home screen and made the MOD V2 patch manual-only. v1.0.18 added the end-of-setup restart prompt.)

extension.summary: Apply tony7bones logo and breadcrumb fixes to Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: Replaces the MOD V2 logo with the standard Estuary wordmark (vendor_logo.png) and restores section labels in the top bar. Run this after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Safe to re-run — original files are backed up once and never overwritten.

extension.summary: Install video add-ons from the Tony.7.Bones repos
extension.description: Pick which video add-ons to install (POV, The Loop, Sports HD, Umbrella). Each is installed with its full dependency closure, resolved live from the repositories already on this box, then enabled so it works straight away. Run the main Tony.7.Bones Setup first so the source repositories are present.
extension.news: The Loop no longer installs Dailymotion. Dailymotion is dropped from The Loop's dependency closure and The Loop's manifest is patched so that import is optional — The Loop enables and browses normally with Dailymotion absent and no required-dependency lock. Only The Loop is affected (POV and Sports HD are unchanged). Note: a future Loop update can restore the Dailymotion requirement; re-run this setup to clear it again. Still stamps origins and skips optional dependencies (no Google Drive / cloud resolvers).
